chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Isma'il, from Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl, from Abi al-Sabbah, who said:
I asked Aba Abdillah عليه السلام about a man who forgot to perform the two rak'ahs at Maqam Ibrahim عليه السلام during the tawaf of hajj and 'umrah,
so he said: If he is still in the town, he should perform two rak'ahs at Maqam Ibrahim عليه السلام, for Allah, Mighty and Majestic, says:
“And take from Maqam Ibrahim a place of prayer.”
And if he has already departed, then I do not instruct him to return.

key_terms.الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ: the two units of prayer required after tawaf
key_terms.طَوَافِ الْحَجِّ: the circumambulation performed as part of hajj
key_terms.مَقَامِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ: the Station of Ibrahim, the place near the Ka'bah associated with the prayer after tawaf

ai.seo_question: What should someone do if they forget the two rak'ahs of tawaf at Maqam Ibrahim during hajj or 'umrah?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding one who forgets the two rak'ahs of tawaf at Maqam Ibrahim عليه السلام during hajj or 'umrah. If the person is still in Makkah, he should perform them there, based on the Qur'anic command; but if he has already departed, he is not ordered to return.
